preregistration: Strategy-Rich CTF v1 — design rationale and benchmark qualification protocol
frozen_before: any SRCTF map, opponent, or rollout exists
phase: successor benchmark. C7 is unaffected and continues on the historical environment.

the_governing_principle.permitted: design the game so that meaningful tradeoffs EXIST
the_governing_principle.prohibited: design the answer -- which strategy should win, or which response Blue ought to use
the_governing_principle.why_this_is_not_self_enforcing: 'tune until the benchmark is strategy-rich' can conceal 'tune until the latent method passes'. The principle needs a mechanical guarantee, which is the latent-free acceptance criterion below.

latent_free_acceptance_criterion.statement: A candidate environment qualifies iff the frozen reversal scanner finds a replicated preference reversal between two legal team responses, confirmed on an unspent block, using REWARD-ONLY baselines.
latent_free_acceptance_criterion.why_it_is_a_firewall: no latent variable, router, or z appears anywhere in the criterion. It is measured on frozen generalist policies with the same instrument that returned C4_NO_REVERSAL, C5_NO_REVERSAL and C6_STAGE1_MECHANICAL_INFEASIBLE.
latent_free_acceptance_criterion.instrument_credibility: that instrument has repeatedly returned negatives, including against the experimenter's preference. An instrument that has said no is what should decide whether an environment qualifies.

the_multiplicity_hazard_at_the_design_le.the_risk: iterating environment designs until the scanner passes is the same multiplicity policed throughout C4-C6, moved up one level -- from 'try another opponent' to 'try another environment'. Twelve variants against a 0.05 bar produce a strategy-rich benchmark by construction.
the_multiplicity_hazard_at_the_design_le.the_rule: ONE_SHOT. Each environment design gets exactly one qualification attempt. Its mechanics must be justified a priori from the design lever it implements. A failure closes that design and requires a NEW preregistration with a new rationale -- never a tweak-and-retry.
the_multiplicity_hazard_at_the_design_le.applies_equally_to: the mechanical affordance gate. It may not be re-run against a tuned map until it passes.

the_historical_environment_is_retained_a.what_it_is: map_a + RULESET_V2, untouched. C1-C7 evidence preserved.
the_historical_environment_is_retained_a.why_it_is_valuable: C4, C5 and C6 established with a validated instrument that this environment LACKS routable strategic demand. That is a paid-for true negative.
the_historical_environment_is_retained_a.the_contrast_it_enables: the method finds nothing where the scanner says there is nothing, and structure where the scanner says there is structure. A method that only ever reports success is far weaker evidence.
the_historical_environment_is_retained_a.prohibited: modifying map_a, RULESET_V2, OP5-OP12 profiles, or any G0-V5 checkpoint for SRCTF purposes

design_targets.team_size: 4v4 minimum. At 2v2 the entire allocation space is 2/0, 1/1, 0/2 and roles cannibalise one another (measured: offence vs contest r = -0.898 across nine opponents).
design_targets.status_of_that_list: POSSIBILITIES, not strategy labels supplied to PPO and not hypotheses about which wins

the_four_dilemmas.home_exposure_vs_offensive_pressure: more agents forward must raise scoring pressure AND make own flag meaningfully easier to attack
the_four_dilemmas.carrier_support_vs_throughput: an escort must genuinely improve carrier survival or capture probability, at the cost of one agent's independent pressure
the_four_dilemmas.concentrated_vs_split: at least two viable approaches; concentrating gives local numerical superiority, splitting creates simultaneous threats with weaker local strength
the_four_dilemmas.interception_vs_static_defense: an interceptor must stop carriers earlier while leaving less protection near home

design_targets.each_requires_an_OPPORTUNITY_COST: a lever that only adds benefit creates no choice and does not count

map.approach: a NEW map, not a patch of map_a
required_properties: a faster but exposed central route
home areas not perfectly defensible from midfield
map.no_dominant_lane: no lane may simply be best. This is a QUALIFICATION CRITERION, tested below, not an aspiration.

reward.why: if escorts or defensive formations appear, they must have emerged because they helped the TASK. This preserves the reward-only claim, which is the scientific core of the result.

families.SR2_FORTRESS: strong home allocation, weak offensive throughput
families.SR6_ADAPTIVE_PRESSURE: changes allocation according to score and game state

held_out_from_the_start.rule: a subset is RESERVED before any training and never used for training, oracle fitting, or model selection
held_out_from_the_start.why_now_and_not_later: reserving at design time yields a real generalization experiment. Carving one out at paper-writing time is selection after the fact.
held_out_from_the_start.which: to be fixed in the qualification artifact, before any SRCTF training run exists

opponent_population.prohibited: opponent identity as a policy input, router feature, or training signal -- inherited from the C5 freeze

mechanical_affordance_gate.purpose: prove the environment CONTAINS strategic affordances before any PPO run. This is the step whose absence cost C4-C6.
mechanical_affordance_gate.method: scripted legal team allocations as probes. No learned policy is involved.
mechanical_affordance_gate.what_a_pass_establishes: changing team allocation changes meaningful consequences in OPPOSING directions
mechanical_affordance_gate.what_a_pass_does_NOT_establish: that any allocation is optimal, that a reversal exists, or that any strategy is worth learning
mechanical_affordance_gate.additional_criterion_no_dominant_lane: no single lane may be best on the task metric across the opponent population, tested with the same clustered-bootstrap machinery
mechanical_affordance_gate.additional_diagnostic: the offence-vs-contest correlation must be materially WEAKER than the historical r = -0.898. A cramped budget is the signature this benchmark exists to remove.
mechanical_affordance_gate.statistics: inherited from C4/C5: episode-clustered bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 12345, LCB95 = q_0.025, support minima 30

freeze_point.when: immediately after the mechanical affordance gate passes
freeze_point.the_hard_line: after this point NO environment tuning may occur on the basis of any PPO, oracle, latent or router result. This is what separates benchmark engineering from iterating until the method wins.

downstream_gate_sequence.1_generalist: G0-SR, reward-only PPO at 4v4 on the mixed population, competence-gated as in C7 Stage 0
downstream_gate_sequence.2_response_oracles: reward-only, trained on weaknesses DISCOVERED from payoff, never on named strategies

3_crossover.note: both directions, with CIs excluding zero, replicated across seeds

4_repertoire_gain.requirement: E[max_pi M(c, pi)] > max_pi E[M(c, pi)], with statistical support
4_repertoire_gain.plain_english: having both policies available must beat always using the best single policy
4_repertoire_gain.why_crossover_alone_is_insufficient: a crossover can exist while the best single policy still captures nearly all available value, in which case a second policy earns nothing
4_repertoire_gain.measured_on: final task outcome, not a screen proxy

downstream_gate_sequence.5_behavioural_distinctness: matched-observation policy distance, so the two policies are not the same policy relabelled
downstream_gate_sequence.6_observability: the already-frozen single-timestep test, unchanged, before any router
downstream_gate_sequence.7_latents: only now. The question becomes 'can a compact latent representation PRESERVE a repertoire already demonstrated to exist?' rather than 'can we force z values to look different?'
downstream_gate_sequence.8_router_and_held_out: router performance and generalization to the reserved opponents

honest_scope.this_is_a_large_engineering_phase: a new map, six opponent families, a new generalist arm, and a qualification harness. Weeks, not hours.
honest_scope.known_risk: opponent construction is error-prone -- C6 hit two separate plumbing failures where profiles resolved correctly but never reached the simulator, and both produced results that looked like findings
reusable_assets: C6A_PUNISH_EXPOSURE, a validated opponent that genuinely abandons its half

prohibited: rewarding any strategy, role, or behavioural diversity
preregistering which response should win against which opponent
tuning the map, rules, or opponents after any PPO/latent/router result
re-running the affordance gate against a tuned design
using held-out opponents for training, oracle fitting, or model selection
opponent identity as a policy or router input
modifying the historical environment or its artifacts
claiming a task-outcome result from a screen proxy
immutability: The qualification protocol above may not change after any SRCTF measurement exists.
